name: setlist
description: Git principles for your Spotify playlists - a desktop playlist editor, cleanup doctor and player backed by version-controlled files you own.
author: ulysses822

scripts.test: npm run test:web && npm run test:rust
scripts.lint: npm run lint:web && npm run lint:rust
scripts.lint:rust: cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings
